cases.given: Canonical 0.10.1 payload and matching release lock
cases.then: Admit only after structural and semantic validation

cases.given: Legacy 0.9.x document
cases.when: Submit through default and explicit compatibility ingress
cases.then: Default rejects; explicit converter emits validated canonical 0.10.1

cases.given: Unsupported profile or operation version
cases.then: Reject unsupported version with zero backend effects

cases.given: Caller includes authority fields or unknown control members
cases.then: Reject caller-owned control authority before effects

cases.given: AMQP identity differs from canonical envelope identity
cases.then: Reject discrepancy instead of choosing one identity

cases.given: Raw JSON contains duplicate keys or alias fields
cases.then: Reject ambiguous JSON before semantic processing

cases.given: Principal lacks database/dataset/Target permission
cases.then: No adapter work and no inaccessible-resource disclosure

cases.given: Resource URI and payload scope identify different documents
cases.then: Reject scope mismatch before routing effects

cases.given: Recipient ActorRef names a prior incarnation
cases.then: Reject stale incarnation rather than address its replacement

cases.given: Two writers hold the same document revision
cases.then: One conditional mutation wins; loser has no authoritative effects

cases.given: Document is deleted then recreated
cases.when: Use the pre-deletion revision on the new incarnation
cases.then: Reject stale revision; authorized head reports current incarnation

cases.given: Patch addresses protected fields through ancestor or escaped paths
cases.then: Reject protected mutation and preserve original revision

cases.given: Batch contains successful and conflicting items
cases.when: Complete out of order then replay parent key
cases.then: Reply in input order and never repeat committed items

cases.given: Original key and semantic digest already committed
cases.then: Return original receipt and event identity without another commit

cases.given: Original key is reused with changed body or precondition
cases.then: Return idempotency-conflict before effects

cases.given: Concurrent identical requests share one key
cases.then: At most one authoritative mutation or Target acceptance

cases.given: Mutation response is lost on one binding
cases.when: Replay original key through another binding
cases.then: Return the same durable outcome without another mutation

cases.given: Authoritative commit succeeds but reply is lost
cases.then: Report unknown until original committed outcome is recovered

cases.given: Outcome retention expired and execution cannot be disproved
cases.when: Retry old identity or query its outcome
cases.then: Report expired/unknown; never assume nonexecution or blindly rerun

cases.given: Mutation committed before original deadline
cases.then: Allow authorized outcome read without extending execution deadline

cases.given: Fresh unadmitted request deadline already expired
cases.then: Reject before mutation or dispatch

cases.given: Replica is behind the session token lower bound
cases.then: Wait within budget or fail; never return stale data as session-consistent

cases.given: Backend cannot meet requested read/view guarantee
cases.then: Return consistency-unavailable without silent downgrade

cases.given: One planned partition is unavailable and allowPartial is false
cases.then: Return incomplete-query rather than successful complete data

cases.given: One planned partition is unavailable and allowPartial is true
cases.then: Return explicit partial coverage and no continuation cursor

cases.given: All partitions answer but requested page limit is reached
cases.then: Coverage may be complete while hasMore is true

cases.given: Cursor belongs to another tenant/query/projection
cases.then: Reject cursor without exposing original scope

cases.given: Topology or retained view changes between pages
cases.then: Return invalidated/expired rather than silently restarting

cases.given: Snapshot merge sees one identity with conflicting revisions
cases.then: Return inconsistent-view instead of arrival-order selection

cases.given: Snapshot support is absent and live-keyset exists
cases.then: Default fails; explicit live mode reports weaker pagination semantics

cases.given: Query exceeds scan/byte/fan-out/merge budget
cases.then: Bound work and memory; return typed exhaustion without false completeness

cases.given: Consumer stops granting stream credit
cases.then: Bound buffers and pause/close with last resumable checkpoint

cases.given: Requested checkpoint precedes retained history
cases.then: Return history-lost instead of silently starting at now

cases.given: Same committed event is redelivered
cases.then: Deduplicate stable event identity without duplicate state mutation

cases.given: Two observers watch one execution
cases.then: Other observer and Target execution continue

cases.given: Target accepted with future schedule
cases.then: Recover same Target/schedule and dispatch intent from durable state

cases.given: Submission includes lease/fence/execution generation
cases.then: Reject supplied runtime authority rather than trusting metadata

cases.given: Caller can write documents but not execute Targets
cases.when: Mutate Target lifecycle through document operations
cases.then: Reject lifecycle bypass; no dispatch is created

cases.given: One recurring schedule and multiple delivery attempts
cases.when: Replay due occurrence then renew lease
cases.then: One occurrence identity; retries/renewals do not create extra occurrences

cases.given: Pending dispatch refers to old schedule revision
cases.then: Old pending dispatch cannot start; running work is not relabeled

cases.given: Schedule has one active and one future occurrence
cases.then: Future admission stops; active execution is reported but not silently canceled

cases.given: Two executions share a schedule
cases.then: Only selected execution enters cancellation arbitration

cases.given: Completion and cancellation race
cases.when: Commit terminal candidates in either order
cases.then: First committed terminal outcome survives all late updates

cases.given: Old attempt holds a superseded fence
cases.then: Reject old authoritative effects for the newer generation

cases.given: Paid remote effect has unknown outcome and reserved budget
cases.then: Do not replenish budget; preserve reservation/reconciliation state

cases.given: Ownership changes between registry check and DB commit
cases.then: Commit boundary rejects stale owner; preflight check alone fails this test

cases.given: Network partition prevents proving current owner
cases.then: No split-brain writes; unavailable where safe authority is unproven

cases.given: Old owner has accepted intents/outcomes/outbox entries
cases.when: Transfer ownership and replay original keys
cases.then: New owner recovers prior identities and outcomes without duplicate commits

cases.given: Broker confirms command before application commit
cases.when: Observe publish confirm and delivery ACK
cases.then: Neither signal is reported as a MutationReceipt

cases.given: Committed outbox event publishes before publisher crashes
cases.then: Republish same event identity; consumer deduplicates

cases.given: Consumer ACK follows durable inbox acceptance only
cases.then: Recover accepted intent; do not claim mutation had already committed

cases.given: Poison message or repeated transient failure
cases.then: Quarantine/typed failure without infinite requeue or false success

cases.given: Caller forges principal headers or cross-tenant reply destination
cases.then: Reject forged authority/destination before protected reply

cases.given: Route loop or repeated stale-route refresh
cases.then: Finite hop/timeout budget; no deadline extension or fresh-key failover

cases.given: Peers use supported 1.0.x spec releases
cases.when: Negotiate wire version and attempt legacy downgrade
cases.then: Use protocol 1.0; no patch-based incompatibility or silent 0.3 fallback

cases.given: Two tenants/peers reuse taskId/contextId and inject authority metadata
cases.then: No cross-scope resolution or authority minted from metadata

cases.given: Initial effectful Send Message response is lost and peer deduplication is unproven
cases.then: Keep outcome unknown; do not blindly create another Task

cases.given: Old binding reports terminal result after replacement
cases.then: Reject stale binding settlement and preserve current execution

cases.given: Artifact append notifications repeat identical or reordered chunks
cases.then: Use offsets/chunk IDs or full snapshot; never dedupe solely by content

cases.given: Stream misses updates during disconnection
cases.then: Reconcile durable Task/artifact state without creating new execution

cases.given: Unprotected remote action continues after local cancellation
cases.then: Preserve local terminal state while reporting external-effect uncertainty

cases.given: Artifact URL redirects to disallowed destination or oversized content
cases.then: Revalidate destination and enforce byte/time limits without credential leakage

cases.given: Recurring Target has pending and completed occurrences
cases.when: Request result without or with concrete executionId
cases.then: Require explicit execution and never represent pending as empty success

cases.given: Two generated releases both claim 0.10.1 but differ in hashes
cases.then: Reject unapproved artifact drift and require explicit repin
